paragraphs.text: Cell counters are a type of counter introduced in the Final Fantasy commander deck Limit Break . They are placed on creatures, making them modified . They have no other inherent rules.
Cell counters first appeared on Sephiroth, Fallen Hero in the Limit Break commander deck.

Cell counters are flavored as the cells of Jenova , an ancient alien and major antagonist of the Final Fantasy VII series . They serve as a central plot point for the series' story and the primary crisis of Final Fantasy VII . Jenova cells were used by the Shinra Electric Power Company to genetically modify humans in a misguided attempt to create a human- Cetra hybrid that would allow the company to find the " Promised Land " and the untold riches within. The Jenova Project resulted in significantly enhanced individuals used as solders by the company. It was this project that created Sephiroth and permanently altered Cloud Strife .
